artistBio:
KHROME is a DJ and producer based in Los Angeles working across bounce, trance, and high tempo club music. The focus has always been simple: people first, music first.

What keeps him in this lane isn’t just the speed or intensity. It’s the atmosphere. The way a room shifts when the right track lands. The way strangers end up moving together without thinking about it. There’s something lighter in this scene. It feels open. Playful. Less concerned with image and more concerned with the experience itself.

His sets are built around that connection. He pays attention to the room and responds to it. Some moments call for pressure, others for release. The goal isn’t to overwhelm people. It’s to keep everyone locked in together, feeling present and involved.

As a Resident for Neo Bounce, KHROME has grown within a community that values movement and shared energy. He has closed for headliners including Andata and GEORGE, also known as Dr. Radsport, and has played direct support for Trancemaster Krause and Bababass3000. Each of those sets came with different expectations, but the approach stayed the same.

He has also performed with crews such as Aftermidnight, LickNDip, SXTCY, Star Crossed, and Inland Groove throughout Los Angeles and the Inland Empire. Whether in warehouses or clubs, the intention remains consistent. The space should feel welcoming. The music should feel alive.

Influenced by artists like Panteros666, ODYMEL, Ueberrest, and Indira Paganotto, along with the faster end of club culture, KHROME continues to shape a sound that feels energetic without losing its sense of humanity.
